canonical.behaviour: An offer approval given with the question tool's button ("Approve from this summary", also with "(Recommended)") or typed as /approve <N> counts as "continue" for the session pause, as a typed "approve" already does. It lifts a pause only when it answers a question or presentation that carries an offer; other answers lift nothing, and a withdrawal still ends the approval.
exclusions: no change to control_intent in phase_gate.py, the offer model or the approval rules in decide()
no git commit or push; the release is a separate step
the main checkout D:/workflow-axa and the installed plugin stay untouched
conditions: GPT-6 Astra reviews the code and the docs until it agrees
test first: the new cases fail before the fix
work only in the worktree D:/workflow-axa-redesign
checks: cd tests && python -X utf8 -m unittest test_approval_hook
full suite: python -X utf8 -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py"
